title: Pope Francis Apostolic Visit & International Security Protocol Force
subtitle: Selected as Core Volunteer for 100,000-Attendee Papal Mass & 10,000-Youth NDC Gathering
body:
During Pope Francis's historic apostolic journey to Myanmar and Bangladesh in late 2017 (themed "Harmony and Peace"), I was given the rare honor of being selected as a primary student volunteer. One afternoon, Father Susanto called me and 19 peers using the famed college pink slips to invite us to serve as official volunteers for the 10,000-youth gathering hosted right on the Notre Dame College campus. 

Shortly after, Father Susanto selected 6 of us from that group into the core volunteer force for the main Papal Mass at Ramna Race Course, attended by over 100,000 people. To prepare for this massive global event, we underwent intensive seminars and training sessions over multiple weeks, coordinating with international security details and learning large-scale protocol management. Witnessing global diplomacy, inter-faith harmony, and international event coordination firsthand was one of the most formative milestones of my college life.

phases.phaseTitle: The Apostolic Journey to Myanmar & Bangladesh
phases.headline: Messenger of Peace: "Shompreeti o Shanti" (Harmony and Peace)
phases.subtitle: The Second Papal Visit in Bangladesh’s History Following Pope John Paul II in 1986
storyParagraphs: On 26 November 2017, Pope Francis departed Rome on an apostolic pilgrimage across South Asia to Myanmar and Bangladesh as a global messenger of peace. Carrying the official Bengali theme "Harmony and Peace" (সম্প্রীতি ও শান্তি / Shompreeti o Shanti), the historic voyage marked only the second time in history that a Bishop of Rome stepped onto Bangladeshi soil, following the historic visit of Pope John Paul II in 1986.

For Bangladesh—a pluralistic nation where the Christian community represents under one percent of the population—the visit carried monumental diplomatic, moral, and inter-religious significance. The world’s gaze was fixed on Dhaka as Pope Francis arrived to champion interfaith solidarity, social justice, and humanitarian empathy during a critical geopolitical juncture.
phases.reflectionQuote: "Carrying the theme 'Harmony and Peace' (Shompreeti o Shanti), Pope Francis arrived as a messenger of unity in only the second papal visit in Bangladesh's history."
phases.imageCaption: Official Visit Emblem: The dove of peace bearing the cross and national lotus in flag colors ("সম্প্রীতি ও শান্তি").

phases.phaseTitle: The Pink Slip Summons & Multi-Agency Protocol Training
phases.headline: The Call of Father Susanto & The Elite 6-Member Core Force
phases.subtitle: Vetted by Holy Cross Leadership for Joint Operations with Vatican & State Security
storyParagraphs: At Notre Dame College, the legendary "pink slips" were historically known as disciplinary summons that sent chills down any student’s spine. But on one memorable November afternoon, a pink slip arrived with a life-changing purpose. Father Susanto, CSC, summoned 20 of us to his office. Standing before the administration, we learned we had been handpicked to serve as official student volunteers for the upcoming youth gathering on our campus grounds.

A few days later, Father Susanto called 6 of us back into his room. He presented an astonishing assignment: we had been chosen to join the elite core volunteer force for the main Papal Mass at Suhrawardy Udyan (Ramna). Many hundreds had applied across parishes and institutions nationwide, yet 6 second-year college students from Notre Dame College were entrusted with direct accreditation at the state level. The emotion and gravity of that moment cannot be expressed in words.

To prepare for such monumental responsibility, we underwent multi-week intensive training seminars and briefings. We coordinated alongside Bangladesh’s Special Security Force (SSF), the Presidential Guard Regiment (PGR), the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP), and the Vatican Gendarmerie / Swiss Guard command. We mastered crowd bottleneck mitigation, ID verification protocols, dog-squad sanitization procedures, and emergency humanitarian corridors.
phases.reflectionQuote: "One day Father Susanto called 20 of us with the pink slip and asked if we would volunteer. After some days, he called 6 of us to join the main mass volunteer force. I was shocked and profoundly honored."

phases.phaseTitle: The 100,000-Attendee Papal Mass at Suhrawardy Udyan
phases.headline: Public Mass & Historic Priesthood Ordination at Ramna
phases.subtitle: Gathering at the Landmark Grounds of Bangladesh’s Independence & March 7 Heritage
storyParagraphs: On the brisk morning of Friday, 1 December 2017, our duties commenced before dawn at Suhrawardy Udyan (historically the Ramna Race Course). The venue possessed profound historical weight—it was the sacred ground where Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman delivered the historic March 7 speech in 1971 and where the instrument of surrender was signed.

Over 100,000 faithful, international diplomats, dignitaries, and cardinals converged from all eight Catholic dioceses of Bangladesh. During the solemn liturgy, Pope Francis conducted a rare public ordination outside the Vatican, ordaining 16 new priests—including 5 from the Congregation of Holy Cross.

As part of the core student protocol unit stationed inside the inner perimeter, we managed crowd access, credentialed gates, and emergency corridors. Later that evening at the Archbishop's House in Kakrail during an interfaith assembly, Pope Francis met and embraced a delegation of Rohingya refugees, publicly uttering the name "Rohingya" for the first time in a defining moment of global moral solidarity.
phases.reflectionQuote: "More than 100,000 people attended the meeting at Ramna Race Course. Witnessing the ordination of sixteen priests and maintaining security corridors gave me a rare masterclass in large-scale systems execution."
phases.imageCaption: Pope Francis greeting thousands of faithful and youth from the Popemobile during the historic public assembly.

phases.phaseTitle: The 10,000-Youth Interreligious Gathering on NDC Grounds
phases.headline: Pope Francis on the Notre Dame College Campus
phases.subtitle: Catholic, Muslim, Hindu & Indigenous Youth Celebrating Under One Sky
storyParagraphs: On Saturday, 2 December 2017, the pinnacle of the pastoral visit occurred directly on the sports ground of Notre Dame College. Over 10,000 young people from across Bangladesh assembled under a magnificent blue-and-white canopy. Uniquely, the audience represented a true reflection of the nation: Catholic youth celebrating shoulder-to-shoulder with Muslim, Hindu, and indigenous peers from colleges and universities nationwide.

When Pope Francis stepped onto the stage accompanied by Cardinal Patrick D'Rozario and security officers, the college erupted in jubilant cheers and traditional cultural melodies. Our student volunteer force stood vigilant along the main access stage and aisles, ensuring security cordons remained intact while allowing the Holy Father to interact warmly with students.

In his historic address, Pope Francis famously urged the youth not to become "couch potatoes" wandering aimlessly through life. He reminded students that God embedded a spiritual "software" inside every human soul that requires continuous updates through prayer, service, and dialogue with parents and grandparents. During the event, the Pope also blessed the foundation cornerstones of both Notre Dame College and the newly established Notre Dame University Bangladesh (NDUB).
phases.reflectionQuote: "Pope Francis reminded us that God placed a spiritual 'software' inside us that requires regular updates through good deeds and dialogue across generations. Standing on our own campus grounds, it was an unforgettable privilege."
phases.imageCaption: Pope Francis on the Notre Dame College stage with Cardinal Patrick D’Rozario, Vatican Swiss Guards, and Bangladesh SSF officers.

pillars.title: International Protocol & High-Stakes Coordination
pillars.desc: Working directly alongside joint commands of the Vatican Gendarmerie, Bangladesh Special Security Force (SSF), and Presidential Guard Regiment taught me the rigor of meticulous preparation, absolute composure under high pressure, and strict adherence to protocol.

pillars.title: Pluralism & Authentic Social Harmony
pillars.desc: Witnessing 10,000 Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, and Christian youth celebrating united on the Notre Dame College grounds proved that diversity is a source of collective strength, and that empathy and mutual respect build lasting harmony across communities.

pillars.title: The Nobility of Silent Stewardship
pillars.desc: Being chosen as 1 of 6 core students out of thousands of applicants instilled profound humility and moral responsibility. True leadership is not seeking the spotlight, but faithfully serving with integrity and quietly safeguarding the mission.
